_doc: Automatic play stats (0.102): when endpoint is set, the game sends this browser's run history (anonymous random player id, no personal data) to the collector Worker in collector/ after every run and once per session; the /analytics/ dashboard reads it back. Empty endpoint = nothing is sent. Setup: collector/README.md. collectorVersion (0.119): the collector/worker.js VERSION this build expects; the dashboard warns when the deployed Worker reports another (it is updated by pasting collector/worker.js into the Cloudflare dashboard).
